title: Governed abandonment and supersession terminal path for unmerged lanes

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Substantive implementation commit containing every control and regression described. Post-merge closeout automation rebinds this field to the authoritative merge SHA.

verifier.independence_note: Executor-produced mechanical evidence. This is not PM approval or independent certification. The orchestrator implemented this lane, so the independent opposite-provider review recorded on the PR carries the validation burden.

verify_full.command: pnpm exec tsx --test scripts/ops/lane-supersede.test.ts scripts/ops/lane-manifest.test.ts scripts/ops/shared.test.ts
verify_full.note: pnpm verify is deferred to PR CI, which is authoritative for this lane.

mutation_test.note: Groups A-R. Each mutation fails only its own regression. Mutation K survived the first 13-group battery (post-condition release verification was not load-bearing) and was closed with a duplicated-lease regression before this bundle was written.
mutation_test.group_results: See docs/06_status/proof/UTV2-1668/verification.md for the per-group failing test names and counts.

write_audit.note: This lane performs no database access of any kind. It changes lane lifecycle control flow only.

runtime_proof.reason: This lane touches no runtime, domain, database or delivery surface. There is no live-DB behaviour to exercise: the command reads GitHub PR state, the current main SHA and the authenticated identity, and writes a lane manifest, a lease record and a transaction receipt on the local filesystem.
external_authorities: GitHub PR state (state, merged, mergedAt, headRefOid)
runtime_proof.authority_injection_note: All three are injected in tests and read via the gh CLI in production, so every refusal path is exercised deterministically without network dependence.
runtime_proof.escalation: If the T1 proof gate requires a live-DB runtime_proof with no applicability exemption, this lane cannot satisfy it and the tier or the gate must be reconciled by PM decision. Flagged rather than worked around.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: status superseded with a mandatory supersession record; test 'a closed unmerged lane reaches a terminal non-shipped state with resources released'

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Verify authoritative PR is closed and unmerged
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Mutations E, F, G, I; state/merged/mergedAt only, mergeCommit never consulted (Mutation L)

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Preserve branch, PR, review, proof and executor history
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: refuses_to_write_superseded_branch (Mutation Q); no branch or history is modified

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Structured reason, actor, timestamp, source PR/branch, successor
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: all mandatory (Mutation A); successor may not equal source (Mutation B)

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Release lease, capacity and file-scope locks transactionally
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: staged receipt; success withheld until verifyReleased passes (Mutation K)

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Never fabricate merge_sha, done, truth-check or shipped claims
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Mutations C and M; claim fixed to source_pr_did_not_merge

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Fail closed on ambiguous PR or lane identity
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Mutations E and I; pr_identity_unresolved and pr_identity_conflict
deterministic transaction id; crash-resume regression; cross-worktree durable root (Mutation R)

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Lock and capacity evaluators exclude the superseded lane
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: verifyReleased asserts exclusion from ACTIVE_LOCK, TOTAL, EXECUTOR and TYPE capacity sets at runtime

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Mutation proof for every control, and refusal remedies executed
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: 18 groups, 0 survivors; the lane-manifest bypass refusal is spawned as a real process and its named remedy then run to success

known_limitations: pnpm type-check does not compile scripts/ops/**; tsconfig.json references only packages/* and apps/*. Tracked separately; deliberately not fixed here.

No pnpm ops:lane-supersede alias: package.json is a singleton path currently locked by another active lane. The command is production-wired as npx tsx scripts/ops/lane-supersede.ts, the same invocation form as tier-classifier and generate-preflight-token.
Applying this transition to the failed predecessor lane happens after this merges, per PM sequencing.
General abandonment without a successor is explicitly out of scope and tracked separately.

sign_off.note: The orchestrator wrote this change and is not its validator. Independent opposite-provider review is required before merge and is recorded on the PR.
